svg.title: Stack, heap, and the pointer that outlived its frame
svg.desc: Blank version of the sketch “Stack, heap, and the pointer that outlived its frame” with all labels removed, for drawing from memory. Three stack frames drawn as boxes on the left and a heap allocation on the right. A green arrow shows make_buf returning a pointer; the make_buf frame is then crossed out in red, and a red arrow shows the caller still holding the address of memory whose owning frame is gone.
svg.text: Stack, heap, and the pointer that outlived its frame
draw it from memory, then compare
